scientific_integrity: A deterministic construction with a coupled globally bounded smooth diffusion. All coefficient and sharpness claims follow from the written analytic derivation; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Independent observation only; sharpness of cumulant rank, not minimal algorithmic state dimension. The tree-graph identity itself is classical; possible implicit equivalent embedding in older diagram literature. Exact checks are finite and analytic proof handles all ranks.
title: All-rank sharpness of the small-noise cumulant cutoff in bounded diffusions
